description: rcf verify run --release <label> --since <ref> with one target (--url, --artefact or --package) runs the cases of e2e-level suites bound to the live external criteria of the specs changed since the last release, plus the declared core-journey smoke suites, against the target. A package target is installed cold. With --record it writes ReleaseVerifyReport v1 under rcf/verify-reports/releases/ and executionStatus verified on each in-scope spec whose external criteria all passed when the smoke run passed; without --record it writes no status and no release report. Catalog and agent modes stay optional ad hoc probes and are refused in release mode.
rationale: Redesign VERIFY section and change 4 (:44-49, :87-90); 09:20Z answers 3 and 4; Q-07 a (10:40Z); D-05 and D-06 (audit section 5), F-14, F-19, F-29, F-32.
title: rcf verify run in release mode writes verified from the bound E2E tests of external criteria against the release target, outside the build cycle
